body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:

br.br:
Claims 1-11. (Cancelled)210
12. (Currently Amended) A rotorcraft comprising:
a fuselage forming a cabin with a cabin floor, the fuselage comprising a lower shell, a side shell, and at least one lateral longeron which together delimit at least one lower lateral fuselage compartment with an opening; and
at least one non-retractable wheel-type landing gear rigidly attached in the at least one lower lateral fuselage compartment and extending at least partly through the opening, the at least one non-retractable wheel-type landing gear comprising:at least one wheel;
a shock absorber with a length axis and a circumferential direction, the shock absorber being connected to the at least one wheel and comprising:
a shock absorber tube, and a shock absorber rod telescopically mounted to the shock absorber tube;
a mounting arm extending laterally from the shock absorber tube, the mounting arm being integrally formed with the shock absorber tube and rigidly attached to a first fitting mounted to the cabin floor and the at least one lateral longeron; and
a link fixation extending laterally from the shock absorber tube, the link fixation being arranged in the circumferential direction of the shock absorber at an
SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.0470.047
angle in a range from 450 to 1200 with respect to the mounting arm and rigidly attached via a linear link component to a second fitting mounted to the lower shell of the rotorcraft.
13. (Original) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the at least one non-retractable wheel- type landing gear further comprises another link fixation extending laterally from the shock absorber tube, the other link fixation being arranged in the circumferential direction of the shock absorber at an angle in a range from 450 to 1200 with respect to the link fixation and rigidly attached via a triangular link component to a third fitting mounted to the lower shell of the rotorcraft.
14. (Original) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the triangular link component is arranged tangentially to the lower shell.
15. (Original) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the linear link component is arranged tangentially to the lower shell.
16. (New) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the link fixation is integrally formed with the shock absorber tube and provided for attachment to the linear link component adapted for linking the shock absorber tube to the second fitting of the rotorcraft.
17. (New) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the other link fixation is integrally formed with the shock absorber tube and provided for
attachment to the triangular link component adapted for linking the shock absorber tube to the third fitting of the rotorcraft.
18. (New) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the link fixation and the other link fixation span in a horizontal plane that is positioned at an angle in a range from 800 to 1000 with respect to the length axis of the shock absorber.
19. (New) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the mounting arm and the other link fixation span in a vertical plane that is oriented at least approximately perpendicular to the horizontal plane.
20. (New) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the shock absorber tube comprises a closed end and an axially opposed open end, wherein the mounting arm is provided close to the closed end, and wherein the link fixation is provided close to the open end.
21. (New) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the shock absorber tube comprises a closed end and an axially opposed open end, wherein the mounting arm is provided close to the closed end, and wherein the link fixation and the other link fixation are provided close to the open end.
22. (New) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the other link fixation forms a hinge axis that is at least approximately arranged perpendicular to the mounting arm.
23. (New) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the mounting arm is rigidly attachable via a single hinge to a single attachment point provided on the first fitting of the rotorcraft, and wherein the single hinge forms a single hinge axis that is at least approximately arranged perpendicular to the mounting arm.
24. (New) The rotorcraft of The rotorcraft of
wherein the hinge axis and the single hinge axis are at least approximately arranged in parallel.
25. (New) A rotorcraft comprising:
a fuselage with a cabin with a cabin floor, the fuselage comprising a lower shell, a side shell, and a longeron which together delimit a lower lateral fuselage compartment with an opening; and
a non-retractable wheel landing gear attached in the lower lateral fuselage compartment and extending at least partly through the opening, the non-retractable wheel landing gear comprising:a wheel;
a shock absorber with a length axis and a circumferential direction, the shock absorber being connected to the wheel and comprising:
a shock absorber tube, and a shock absorber rod telescopically mounted to the shock absorber tube;
a mounting arm extending from the shock absorber tube, the mounting arm attached to a first fitting mounted to the cabin floor and the lateral longeron; and
a link fixation extending from the shock absorber tube, the link fixation being arranged in the circumferential direction of the shock absorber at an angle in a range from 450 to 1200 with respect to the mounting arm and attached via a linear link component to a second fitting mounted to the lower shell of the rotorcraft.
